title: Strictly Positive Parity Laws and the Limits of Marginal Certificates: Exact Heat-Bath Spectrum and Optimal Variance Tensorization
abstract: Strictly positive Boolean laws with density 1+t product_i x_i have identical proper coordinate marginals for |t|<1. Their complete single-site heat-bath spectrum is computed for arbitrary positive site rates. With total rate R and minimum m, the gap is [R-sqrt((R-2m)^2+4t^2 m(R-m))]/2, and its reciprocal is the optimal variance tensorization constant. This constant is unbounded at fixed dimension and rates as |t| tends to1 while all proper marginal data remain fixed. No finite-valued function of those data bounds the constant on the whole strictly positive class; neither hard support nor exact-zero product certification is needed. The older exact-zero argument is stated with a literal input map. Unsupported audit, spatial-decay and entropy claims are withdrawn. Priority is unestablished; no new formal replay, fixed-local Gibbs or physical mass-gap theorem is claimed.
